new_sources.title: Adaptive Transfer Learning on Graph Neural Networks
new_sources.citation_role: Graph meta-regularization, gradient-similarity weighting and virtual/meta/recomputed main-model update ancestry.

findings.shared_core: §3.1 explicitly shares GNN parameters across target and auxiliary task-specific layers. It does not specify the candidate shared dense predictor basis/private-factor decomposition.
findings.private_state: Auxiliary task-specific layers are named, but persistent same-task private learner rows and separate optimizer histories are not specified.
findings.episode_geometry: Algorithm1 line5 splits supervised batch into train/meta folds. No endpoint-based split or both-positive-and-negative endpoint exclusion is specified in selected methods.
findings.learning_credit: Eqs7–8/Algorithm1 lines11–12 differentiate target loss through a virtual joint GNN update to weighting-model parameters w. The meta variable is w, not the shared GNN theta; no private-only inner map is specified.
findings.recomputed_commit: Algorithm1 lines14–19 recompute similarity/joint loss at original theta_t using updated w_(t+1), then update persistent theta. Actual update uses full Dsup plus Daux, including the meta fold. This directly establishes generic graph recomputation order and differs from the candidate private inner-only recomputation.
findings.deployment: The selected method optimizes a target-task GNN and task-specific heads. Persistent raw-logit ensemble serving without adaptation is not specified; deployment implementation was not read.

new_sources.title: Task Aligned Meta-learning based Augmented Graph for Cold-Start Recommendation
new_sources.citation_role: Graph recommendation with cluster-defined meta tasks, positive/negative pair losses and support/query adaptation; concrete pair separation is not endpoint-union exclusion.

findings.shared_core: §4.3 specifies LightGCN-style embedding propagation, attribute concatenation and inner-product prediction. A persistent shared dense predictor basis with private fast factor rows is not specified.
findings.private_state: §3.2 and §4.5 describe learning an initial parameter and adapting it to tasks/new users/items. Algorithm1 uses theta_k without explicitly defining its reset/carry rule; persistent same-task private rows/separate Adam histories and served ensemble are not established by the scope.
findings.episode_geometry: §4.2.2 clusters users with K-means and makes support/query mutually exclusive as interaction sets. §4.3.3 Eq14 uses observed and unobserved user-item pairs. Pair-set disjointness does not entail exclusion of both endpoints of all positive and negative query pairs. The exact exclusion is not specified.
findings.learning_credit: §4.5 Eqs17–18 and Algorithm1 lines9–12 give support inner learning followed by query second-order meta update to initial parameters. A private-only inner/shared-only outer state partition is not specified.
findings.recomputed_commit: Algorithm1 proceeds from global meta update to graph augmentation, line13. No recomputed persistent inner-only private commit from unchanged old private state is specified.
findings.deployment: §3.2 explicitly updates parameters on meta-test support and evaluates query. §4.5 says new-user/item representations are rapidly adapted. This differs from the candidate adaptation-free served ensemble.

unresolved_details: Algorithm theta_k initialization/carry convention is not explicitly defined in selected algorithm; no author code inspected.
Attribute-oriented autoencoder §4.2.1 and Eq2–5 not read; Algorithm1 references Eq5.
Experimental split proportions, evaluation implementation and published outcomes were not inspected.
